prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Fort Lauderdale FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” company, but **CIMCO Management** looks like a strong first choice for a Fort Lauderdale rental home based on the information available: it says it manages single-family homes locally, offers tenant screening, leasing, rent collection, maintenance coordination with 24/7 emergency coverage, and monthly owner reporting, with a stated **flat 8% management fee**.

I’d also compare **Real Property Management United**, which serves single-family homes in Fort Lauderdale and lists a **7.9% plan** (with a separate leasing fee), and **Luxury Property Care**, which advertises local service and charges **8–10% of collected rent**, plus a one-time leasing fee when it places a tenant. Those prices and service claims are from the companies’ own listings, so confirm them directly.

Before choosing, ask each for a sample management agreement and a full fee schedule—including leasing, renewals, inspections, maintenance markups, and cancellation terms—and speak with a couple of current owner clients.
